meta.notes: An item trigger. msm:while_worn fires msm_examples:night_vision_helmet_worn every 100 ticks (five seconds) while the helmet is in the head slot, and only there: it needs msm:armor. The event gives the wearer 20 seconds of night vision, so the effect never runs low enough to flicker and ends shortly after the helmet comes off. msm:armor makes it an iron helmet. It reuses the vanilla iron helmet model.
